mentions.name: Fragno
mentions.description: A meta framework for building "full-stack" libraries that bundle frontend hooks, backend routes, and a database schema into a single package. It lets library authors define webhook handlers and simple database operations, moving complexity from the library user to the author and making API integrations easier.
mentions.problem: API integrations push complexity onto library users; writing to a database from a library is a powerful but complex concept.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a meta framework for building "full-stack" libraries. I.e. libraries that bundle frontend hooks, backend routes, and a database schema into a single package.
